about: Expected results of the paired comparison, derived by hand from contract §7. Each case applies its input operations to a copy of base.input and its expected operations to a copy of base.expected.

operations.set: ["set", path, value]: replace or create the dict key, or replace the list element, at the path
operations.delete: ["delete", path]: remove the dict key or the list element at the path
operations.append: ["append", path, value]: append the value to the list at the path
operations.path: a list of steps; a step is a dict key, a list index, or {"id": x}: the one element of the list whose id is x
operations.numbers: floats are compared with an absolute tolerance of 1e-12; everything else is compared exactly

expected.claim: no regression was detected on this evaluation set; not evaluated: code-gen-mbpp, extract-ja, ja-reading, long-ja-4k, synth-format

cases.name: clean_pair
cases.about: Identical outputs and scores give no_regression_found.

cases.name: regression_only
cases.about: One item that the baseline got right and the candidate got wrong.

cases.name: improvement_only
cases.about: An improvement alone is not a regression.

cases.name: improvements_do_not_offset_a_regression
cases.about: Three improvements and one regression stay regression_found.

cases.name: a_regression_at_an_exact_tie_still_counts
cases.about: The baseline top-2 gap at the diverging position is 0.

cases.name: critical_failure_outranks_a_regression
cases.about: An empty candidate output and a regression give critical_failure.

cases.name: incomplete_outranks_everything
cases.about: A missing candidate output, a critical failure and a regression.

cases.name: missing_baseline_output
cases.about: The baseline has no record of one item.

cases.name: record_not_in_the_set
cases.about: The candidate has a record whose id is not in the set.

cases.name: duplicate_id
cases.about: The candidate has two records of one item.

cases.name: contract_hash_differs_in_a_run_record
cases.about: The candidate run was made with another contract.json.

cases.name: contract_version_differs_in_a_score_summary
cases.about: The baseline was scored under another contract version.

cases.name: items_file_differs_between_the_scorings
cases.about: The two runs were scored against different item files.

cases.name: tokenizer_differs_between_the_scorings

cases.name: scorer_differs_between_the_scorings
cases.about: The two runs were scored with different Python versions.

cases.name: item_hash_differs
cases.about: The scoring reported an item whose hash differs from the committed set.

cases.name: set_name_differs
cases.about: The candidate run names another set.

cases.name: long_context_token_count_differs
cases.about: A long-context input has another length than the committed count.

cases.name: input_tokens_differ_between_the_runs
cases.about: Baseline and candidate read different token ids for one item.

cases.name: baseline_runtime_error
cases.about: A baseline record carries an error; its truncated output was scored incorrect.

cases.name: top2_differs
cases.about: The scoring reported a record whose top2 does not match its generated tokens.

cases.name: code_items_not_scored_yet
cases.about: The code items are still pending in both scorings.

cases.name: malformed_candidate_records
cases.about: The scoring reported malformed records: one with an id, one by line number.

cases.name: same_output_scored_differently
cases.about: Identical generated tokens with different correctness cannot be trusted.

cases.name: same_output_ids_stopped_differently
cases.about: Equal output_ids with different correctness cannot be trusted, even when one run stopped on a stop token and the other at its limit.

cases.name: run_record_says_unfinished
cases.about: A run record whose item count is below its input count is an interruption.

cases.name: run_record_without_counts
cases.about: A run record without the counts is not judged as unfinished.

cases.name: run_record_without_finish
cases.about: A run record with all items written and no finish time is an interruption.

cases.name: run_record_with_null_finish
cases.about: A null finish time is the same as no finish time.

cases.name: run_record_without_counts_or_finish
cases.about: A run record with neither counts nor a finish time is not judged.

cases.name: reasons_are_listed_in_a_fixed_order
cases.about: Three reasons at once keep the fixed order of the reasons.

cases.name: candidate_runtime_error
cases.about: A candidate record carries an error; its truncated output is also a regression.

cases.name: candidate_non_finite_logits
cases.about: A candidate record saw non-finite logits and ended with an error.

cases.name: empty_candidate_output
cases.about: The candidate output has no tokens and the baseline output has some.

cases.name: empty_output_in_both
cases.about: An empty output that the baseline also has is not a critical failure.

cases.name: control_token_in_the_candidate
cases.about: The candidate output holds a control token and the baseline output none.

cases.name: control_token_in_both

cases.name: ids_next_to_control_tokens
cases.about: Ids 45, 53, 99, 102, 104, 255998, 258879 and 258885 are not control tokens.

cases.name: eight_tokens_three_times_and_seven_more

cases.name: one_token_thirty_one_times
cases.about: One token 31 times is not a repetition.

cases.name: one_token_thirty_two_times
cases.about: One token 32 times is an 8-token sequence 4 times in a row.

cases.name: three_tokens_eleven_times

cases.about: 3 tokens 12 times is a 9-token sequence 4 times in a row.

cases.name: repetition_in_both

cases.name: repetition_inside_a_longer_output
